name: Honoka Asakawa
source:
A university student in Sapporo, her public persona of a quiet and studious young woman hiding her newfound obsession with the arts of blood magic.

This unexpectedly allows her to travel to the Sapporo of a century past and meet the woman named Yasue, but the true consequences of her peek into the hidden world of mages and magic are only just beginning to unfold.

[From Steam]
